plainTranslation: A's love and values meets B's mind. The opposition pulls them into push-and-pull.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep:
This connection asks you to stretch beyond your usual understanding of affection.

This person may communicate care in ways that feel unfamiliar to you. The way they flirt, compliment, joke, or express appreciation may not be what you instinctively recognize as warmth. Still, there may be something magnetic about the contrast. Their way of expressing affection can challenge your assumptions and open you to forms of care you might not have noticed before.

Oppositions often bring us face-to-face with another perspective. In this case, the contrast can be compelling. This person may express warmth, affection, or appreciation in ways that feel unfamiliar to you. Their approach can stretch your understanding of connection, showing you that care does not always arrive in the form you expect. Over time, you may discover new ways of giving and receiving affection through the differences between you.

The challenge is that affection does not always arrive in a recognizable form. One person may think they are showing care, while the other does not feel cared for at all. What one person sees as thoughtful may feel distant to the other. What feels sincere may feel awkward. What seems obvious may not register at all.

Both people can end up feeling unseen. Each may be trying to connect in a genuine way, but what they offer is not what the other person needs. Even when there is care between you, it can be difficult to feel fully reached or understood.

The more clearly you learn how each of you gives and receives affection, the easier it becomes to recognize the care that is already there.
